notes: Voice cast for Mipo's Magical World. One fixed ElevenLabs voice per character, reused in every episode.
Voice IDs are NOT stored here. Each character points to an environment variable (set it in mipo/.env).
Never clone a real child's voice. Use ElevenLabs Voice Design (or a licensed library voice / adult voice actor) and keep the same Voice ID forever.
Episode 1 Shorts (30 s): every line is Mipo. Episode 1 long edition (11 min): narrator + Mipo + Blue Bird + Bunny + Baby Deer + Little Purple.

mipo.description: Mipo: warm, cheerful, natural young boy, about 6-7 years old, clear American English, friendly storyteller energy, calm, gentle excitement, never shouting.
mipo.voice_design_prompt: A warm, cheerful young American boy, about 6 or 7 years old, speaking clearly and gently like a friendly storyteller for small children. Bright and curious, soft smile in the voice, calm pace, never shouty. Clean studio recording.

narrator.description: Storyteller (future episodes): warm, friendly, gentle adult storyteller, clear American English, soothing and playful, slow enough for ages 2-7.
narrator.voice_design_prompt: A warm, friendly adult storyteller reading a picture book to young children. Gentle, playful, clear American English, slow and soothing pace, smiling tone. Clean studio recording.

bird.description: Blue Bird (non-speaking in Ep1; chirps are SFX). If it speaks later: tiny, bright, sing-song, cheerful.

bunny.description: White Bunny (non-speaking in Ep1). If it speaks later: soft, shy, sweet, gentle giggle.

deer.description: Baby Deer (non-speaking in Ep1). If it speaks later: gentle, kind, a little slow and dreamy.

little_purple.description: Little Purple (Ep1 long edition): tiny, soft, shy at first, then bubbly and joyful.
little_purple.voice_design_prompt: A tiny, soft, sweet magical voice of a shy little paint droplet, gentle and bubbly when happy, clear American English, for young children. Clean studio recording.
